description: Changes the settings of an automation set up from Cosend’s “Quote requests” recipe, named by id, as its settings page in Cosend does: the settings given replace their values, the rest keep theirs, and the result is saved as a new version. If the automation is switched on, the new settings go live with the save, or the save is refused in words and it keeps running what it ran; if it is off, they wait for it to be switched on. An automation from another recipe, or one written by hand, is refused. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the new version.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The automation set up from the “Quote requests” recipe whose settings change.

settings.description: The settings to change, as the recipe’s settings form asks them. A setting left out keeps the value it has.

keywords.description: A message containing any of these starts the questions. Any case.
keywords.title: Keywords

notify_owner.description: We email it to the owner and admins.
notify_owner.title: Send me the summary

priority.description: The chat comes to you with this priority. The Inbox lists the highest first.
priority.title: Priority in the Inbox

questions.description: Up to three, asked one at a time.
questions.title: Questions

tag.description: Shown on the chat in the Inbox.
tag.title: Tag on the chat
